notes.title: v0.2.2 patch notes
notes.content: [p]good morning! This is just a minor patch to fix a few softlocks/crashes and finish up a few small things that weren't ready in time for release.[/p][p][/p][h3]new features:[/h3][list][*][p]added OpenDyslexic font option in the accessibility settings[/p][/*][*][p]better Linux support maybe? Check [url="https://steamcommunity.com/app/3776680/discussions/0/586147117689655844/"]the forum thread[/url] for up-to-date info[/p][/*][/list][h3]bugfixes / tiny stuff:[/h3][list][*][p]fixed a softlock where the dog wouldn't go to sleep[/p][/*][*][p]attempted to fix a rare softlock in the stage play (i couldn't replicate it but i put in some safeguards)[/p][/*][*][p]fixed some other other minor bugs and crashes[/p][/*][*][p]any crashes during startup or during level load should generate error logs now[/p][/*][*][p]capes don't stretch weird when you spin anymore[/p][/*][*][p]a few small graphic/text adjustments to make some things more clear[/p][/*][*][p]fixed a few weird behaviors when using photo mode and resuming time with Cleru offscreen[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]thanks for playing! Remember to love yourself. 🍓[/p]
